scope: 12 candidate text tasks, three paired baseline tasks and one independent anonymous textual review; no video evaluation

execution_conditions.task_agents: Independent contexts with no parent turn history; identical inherited host settings; exact model identifier unavailable
execution_conditions.permitted_inputs: Specified frozen skill, requested references and task; T12 additionally its input plan and scripts
execution_conditions.effects: Local text and files only, no network, generation or platform submission
execution_conditions.reading_logs: Agent-reported paths and hashes, checked by parent; not a system-level access trace

limits: One execution per task and version, one reviewer, the same inherited host settings; no universal success rate or causal quality uplift claimed.
Holdout wording was not used to revise the rules; domains were anticipated in the plan.
Version-identifying output path prefixes are anonymized only in T12 review copy; raw answers remain intact.
Frozen full runtime directories and release ZIP files remain in the local workspace; this evidence directory stores manifests rather than a standalone copy of every runtime file.
No video, engine, timing, cost or token benchmark.
